summary: Executed backend and frontend regression for content refresh, hero image transparency, route navigation, and admission enquiry integration on public URL. All requested flows passed.
action_items: Optional hardening: restrict CORS origins instead of wildcard when allow_credentials is true.
critical_code_review_comments: In /app/backend/server.py, CORS is configured with allow_credentials=true and wildcard default origin ('*'); this is a security risk and should be limited to trusted origin(s).

Hero uses uploaded school image URL, hero content panel is transparent (rgba alpha 0.1) with backdrop blur, all key routes render updated school content, contact form submit succeeds with toast, and API regression confirms POST/GET persistence of extended admission fields.
